description: Disclosure of every remote network call made by Diamesh, per QVAC Hackathon I submission requirements. All clinical AI inference (completion, RAG, embeddings, vision, tool calling) runs 100% on-device via @qvac/sdk and is NOT listed here. No patient/case data is ever sent to any remote endpoint.

remoteCalls.name: Model weight downloads (one-time setup)
remoteCalls.purpose: Download GGUF model weight files to local disk (apps/api/models/) so all inference can run offline afterwards.
remoteCalls.dataSent: None (HTTP GET only, no patient/case data).

remoteCalls.name: Vision model weights (QVAC registry)
remoteCalls.trigger: First call to getVisionModel() (apps/api/src/models/pool.ts) when a case includes images
remoteCalls.purpose: QVAC SDK resolves the registry://hf/... model source and downloads+caches the SmolVLM2-500M vision model and its projection model on first use.
remoteCalls.dataSent: None (model download only, no patient/case data).
remoteCalls.frequency: One-time per machine; cached locally afterwards.

remoteCalls.name: QVAC P2P delegation (optional)
remoteCalls.trigger: Settings page — provider mode (startQVACProvider) or consumer mode (P2P_PEER_PUBLIC_KEY configured)
hosts: QVAC P2P network (peer-to-peer, no fixed host — peers connect via public key)
remoteCalls.purpose: Optional QVAC SDK feature allowing a peer device to delegate inference to another local device the user controls. Off by default; requires explicit configuration of a peer public key. Always falls back to local inference (delegate: { fallbackToLocal: true }).
remoteCalls.dataSent: If enabled, prompts/inference requests are sent to the user-configured peer device only (not a third-party cloud service).
remoteCalls.frequency: Only when explicitly enabled by the user in Settings.
